title: Air Fryer Fried Chicken
description: Make fried chicken in an air fryer — with a buttermilk marinade and tons of delicious spices, it's just as crispy and tasty as if it were fried in oil!
ingredients: 1.5 pounds bone-in chicken pieces, with skin

steps.text: Make the marinade: Combine buttermilk, hot sauce, and salt in a large gallon-sized resealable bag. Add chicken and knead well to ensure chicken is coated with marinade. Marinate in the refrigerator, 8 hours to overnight.
Make the seasoning: Combine flour, both paprikas, garlic salt, onion powder, salt, pepper, cumin, thyme, basil, and oregano in a second gallon-sized resealable bag. Shake to combine.
Remove chicken from marinade and shake off excess. Add chicken to the seasoning bag. Seal the bag and shake to coat.
Preheat an air fryer to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).

Spray chicken with cooking spray. Air fry until chicken is no longer pink at the bone and the juices run clear, about 20 minutes, turning halfway through. An instant-read thermometer inserted near the bone should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).
